senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (पणते) also 10th cl. (पणयति)
To negociate, to treat or transact business.
(पणयति)
To praise.

m. (-णः)
1 Measure of account, in cowries or shells, twenty gandas or eighty cowries; also a weight of copper of similar value.
2 Wages or hire.
2 A stake at play, a bet, a wager.
4 Gaming, playing.
5 Playing with dice.
6 Price.
7 Wealth, property.
8 A commodity for sale.
9 Business.
10 A distiller.
11 A house, a dwelling.
E.
पण to do business, aff. अच्.

m. (-णः)
1 Trade, traffic.
2 Praise.
3 The hand.
E.
पण to be of price, &c. घञ् aff.

m. (-न्थिः)
A fair, a market.
E.
पण a commodity, ग्रन्थि a knot.

f. (-ता)
1 The state or condition of a pledge or stake.
2 Price, value.
E.
तल् added to पण; also with त्व, पणत्वं.

n. (-नं)
1 Sale, selling.
2 Betting.
E.
पण to do business, aff. ल्युट्.

mf. (-वः-वा)
A sort of musical instrument; a small drum or tabor.
E.
पण business or price, वा to sound, aff. क, it is also प्रणव.

m. (-सः)
A commodity, an article of sale or traffick.
E.
पण to do business, Uṇādi aff. असच्.

f. (-ना)
A prostitute, a whore.
E.
पण price, अङ्गना a woman.

f. (-या)
1 Business, affair, transaction, buying and selling, &c.
2 Profits or receipts of trade.
3 A market place.
E.
पण to negociate, in the causal form, अच् and टाप् affs. or पण and अय income, it also occurs mas. (-यः)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Praised.
2 Transacted.
E.
पण to praise, aff. क्त.

n. (-णं)
Agreement, engagement, contract.
E.
पण price, अर्पण delivering.

n. (-स्थि)
The small shell used as coin, a Cowri.
E.
पण business, and अस्थि a bone; also with कन् added पणास्थि.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Praised.
2 Transacted as business.
E.
पण to praise, aff. क्त; also पणायित.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Vendible, fit or intended for sale.
2 To be transacted, negotiable^1.
3 To be praised.
E.
पण to deal, aff. तव्य.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 A catamite.
2 A eunuch.
f. (-ण्डा)
1 Wisdom, understanding.
2 Science, learning.
E.
पडि to go, aff. अच्, or पण to deal, Uṇādi aff. ड; also with कन added पण्डक.

n. (-र्व्वं)
Non-occurrence of the results of fate or destiny.
E.
पण्ड, and अपूर्व्व unprecedented.

m. (-तः)
1 A scholar, a teacher, a Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, or one read in sacred science, and teaching it to his disciples.
2 Incense.
E.
पण्डा learning, इतच् aff.

m. (-न्यः)
An ignorant and vain person, a pedant, one who thinks himself a Paṇḍita or scholar.
E.
पण्डित learned, मन to think, खश aff.; also with णिनि aff. पण्डितमानिन्.

m. (-नी)
An arrogant and ignorant man: see the last.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Become wise from a state of ignorance.
E.
पण्डित used as a verb, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
1 To be sold, saleable, vendible.
2 To be praised.
3 To be transacted as business.
f. (-ण्या)
Heart pea: see पिण्या.
E.
पण to deal, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Excellent, praise-worthy.
E.
पण to praise, aff. ण्यत्.

n. (-त्वं)
Prosperity in trade, profit.
E.
पण्य, and फलत्व fruitfulness.

n. (-ल्यं)
The price of a commodity.
E.
पण्य, and मूल्य price.

f. (-का)
1 A stall, a shop, a place of sale.
2 A market.
E.
पण्य vendible, and वीथी a shop, &c. कन् added.

f. (-थी)
1 A stall, &c.
2 A market: see the last.

f. (-ला)
1 A market.
2 A shop, a ware-room.
E.
पण्य vendible, and शाला a hall.

f. (-स्त्री)
A whore.
E.
पण्य vendible, and स्त्री a woman.

f. (-ना)
A prostitute, a whore.
E.
पण्य to be sold, अङ्गना a woman; also पणाङ्गना.

m. (-वः)
A trader.
n. (-वं)
A market, a fair.
E.
पण्य a vendible, and आजीव a livelihood.

n. (-कं)
A market.
E.
कन् added to the last; also पण्यजीवकं.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Saleable, vendible.
E.
पण्य, and अर्ह fit for.

m. (-णिः)
The hand.
f. (-णिः)
A place of sale, a shop, a market.
E.
पण to be of price, &c. Uṇādi aff. इन्.

f. (-का)
A sort of spoon or ladle.
E.
पाणि the hand, कन् aff.

f. (-ती)
A bride, one wedded according to the ritual.
E.
पाणि the hand, and ग्टहीत taken: see the next: when the compound means merely taken by the hand, the form is पाणिग्टहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).

n. (-णं)
1 Marriage.
2 Laying hold of the hand.
E.
पाणि the hand, and ग्रहण taking, the junction of the hands of the bride and bridegroom, forming part of this ceremony.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Matrimonial.
E.
पाणिग्रहण, and ठक् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Laying hold of the hand.
2 Marriage.
E.
पाणि, and ग्राह taking.

m. (-घः)
1 A drummer, one who plays on a tabor, &c. with his hands.
2 Playing upon a hand instrument.
3 A workman, a handicraftsman.
E.
पाणि the hand, हन to strike, ठक् aff. and घ substituted for the root.

m. (-तः)
1 Striking with the hands, boxing.
2 A boxer, or one who strikes with his hand.
E.
पाणि the hand, and घात blow.

n. (-ल्यं)
Fidgeting with the hands, snapping the fingers, &c.
E.
पाणि the hand, चापल्य unsteadiness.

m. (-जः)
A finger nail.
E.
पाणि the hand, जन to be born, aff. ड.

n. (-लं)
1 The palm of the hand.
2 A measure of two Tolas.
E.
पाणि, and तल below.

n. (-लं)
A measure of two Tolas.

m. (-नः)
A name of PĀṆINI: see the next.

m. (-निः)
PĀṆINI, a Muni and inspired grammarian.
E.
पणिन् a proper name, and इञ् aff. of descent.

m. (-यः-या-यं)
Connected with or derived from PĀṆINI, the grammarian, (as a scholar, a rule, &c.)
E.
पाणिनि the saint, and छ aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Who blows through the hands.
2 Obscure, dark, (as a path, where a noise is made with the hands, to frighten away snakes, &c.)
E.
पाणि the hand, ध्मा to blow or breathe, aff. खञ्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Who or what drinks from the hand.
E.
पाणि, and धे to drink, स्वश् aff.

n. (-दं)
The hands and feet.
E.
पाणि the hand, and पाद the foot.

n. (-नं)
Marriage.
E.
पाणि the hand, पीडन paining, taking: see पाणिग्रहण.

m. (-भुक्)
The glomerous fig tree, (F. glomerata.)
E.
पाणि the hand, and भुज् what eats.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Possessed of hands.
E.
पाणि and मतुप् aff.

n. (-क्तं)
A missile weapon, one thrown with the hand, as a dart, a spear.
E.
पाणि the hand, and मुक्त loosed.

m. (-ट्)
A nail.
E.
पाणि, and रुह to grow, क्विप् aff.

m. (-दः)
A drummer, playing on a drum or tabor with the hand.
E.
पाणि the hand, and वाद who sounds; also with कन् added पाणिवादक.

f. (-र्य्या)
A rope, a cord.
E.
पाणि the hand, सृज to go, aff. ण्यत्.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Held in the hand.
E.
पाणि, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-मः)
Offerings made to Brahmans where consecrated fire is not used.
E.
पाणि, and होम burnt offering.

n. (-णं)
Marriage.
E.
पाणौ with the hand, and करण making.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Pale or yellowish white.
m. (-रः)
1 Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.)
2 A plant, commonly Marüa or Marūvaka.
n. (-रं)
1 Many-flowered jasmine.
2 Red chalk.
E.
पडि to go, अर Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel made long; also पाण्डुर.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Śitala, (perhaps Phrynium dichotomum): see शीतला.
E.
पाण्डर pale white, पुष्पी flower, aff. कन्.

m. (-वः)
A Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU; especially applied to YUDHIṢṬHIRA and his four brothers.
E.
पाण्डु a proper name, and अण् patronymick aff.

m. (-लः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पाण्डव a Pāṇḍava, and अभी courage, (not fear,) ल who gives.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पाडव a Pāṇḍava, and अयन going, accompanying; being the friend and ally of the Pāṇḍu princes.

m. (-यः)
A descendant of Pāṇḍu.
E.
पाण्डु, and ढक् aff.

nf. (-त्यं-ती)
Scholarship, learning.
E.
पण्डित a teacher, aff. ष्यञ्, the semivowel rejected before the feminine aff.

mfn. (-ण्डुः-ण्डुः-ण्डु)
Pale or yellowish white.
m. (-ण्डुः)
1 Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.)
2 The name of a sovereign of ancient Delhi, and nominal father of YUDHIṢṬHIRA and the other four Pāṇḍava princes.
3 The jaundice.
4 A white elephant (?).
f. (-ण्डुः)
A plant, commonly Maṣāni, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
पडि to go, aff. कु, and the penultimate vowel made long.

m. (-कः)
1 The jaundice.
2 A name of Pāṇḍu.
3 A pale or yellowish white, (the colour.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-लः)
1 A sort of blanket or warm upper garment.
2 A kind of stone, (Limestone or marble?)
3 The housings of a royal elephant.
E.
पाण्डु pale, and कम्बल blanket.

m. (-ली)
1 A carriage covered with a sort of blanket.
2 The housings of a royal elephant.
E.
पाण्डुकम्बल a blanket, and इनि aff.

m. (-गः)
A plant, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
2 A white elephant.
E.
पाण्डु pale, नाग a plant or elephant.

m. (-त्त्रः)
Either of the Pāṇḍava princes.
E.
पाण्डु and पुत्त्र son; also similar compounds, as पाण्डुनन्दन, &c.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Having no distinguishing or auspicious mark on the body, &c.
E.
पाण्डु pale, &c., and पृष्ठ back.

m. (-मः)
A country with a light-coloured soil.
E.
पाण्डु, pale, and भूमि earth, aff. अच्.

f. (-मृत्)
1 A country in which the soil is of a whitish colour.
2 Chalk.
E.
पाण्डु pale, and मृत् earth.

f. (-का)
1 The opal.
2 A pale soil.
E.
पाण्डु pale, and मृत्तिका earth.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Of a yellowish white colour.
m. (-रः)
1 A pale or yellowish white.
2 The jaundice.
3 A tree: see मरुवक.
n. (-रं)
The white leprosy, vitiligo.
E.
पाण्डु pale, and र added.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Having no distinguishing or auspicious marks on the body, &c.
E.
पाण्डुर pale, and पृष्ठ the back.

m. (-मः)
A plant, (Echites antidysenterica.)

m. (-गः)
Whiteness, pallor.
E.
पाण्डु, and राग colour.

f. (-मा)
A plant, (Glycine debilis)
E.
पाण्डु pale, लोमन् hair or fibres.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
White.
m. (-र्णः)
Whiteness.
E.
पाण्डु, and वर्ण colour.

f. (-रा)
Light-coloured gravel, (disease.)
E.
पाण्डु, and शर्क्करा sugar.

f. (-ला)
A name of DRAUPADĪ.
E.
पाण्डु a Pāṇḍu prince, शर्म्म fortune, aff. इलच्.

m. (-कः)
The offspring of a Caṇḍāla by a Vaidehī woman, a maker of mats, baskets, &c. a worker with bambus, and reeds.

m. (-स्यः)
A Brahman who reads the Vedas upon receiving a gift at a Śrāddha.
E.
पाणि, and आस्य face or mouth, having his mouth in his hand.
